description: This file implements server-side weapon firing effects and related functionalities for the game Unvanquished, including weapon effects, damage application, and special attack mechanics.

methods.name: TakesDamages
methods.description: Checks if an entity can take damage based on its state and type.

methods.name: G_ForceWeaponChange
methods.description: Switches the player's weapon to a specified weapon, with fallback to the first available weapon.

methods.name: GiveMaxClips
methods.description: Refills the weapon's spare clips to maximum.

methods.name: GiveFullClip
methods.description: Refills the current weapon's ammo to maximum.

methods.name: G_GiveMaxAmmo
methods.description: Refills both clips and ammo for the player's current weapon.

methods.name: CanUseAmmoRefill
methods.description: Checks if the entity can refill ammo based on current ammo state.

methods.name: G_RefillAmmo
methods.description: Refills ammo or clips, triggers an event if specified.

methods.name: G_RefillFuel
methods.description: Refills jetpack fuel if applicable.

methods.name: G_FindAmmo
methods.description: Attempts to find nearby ammo sources to refill.

methods.name: G_FindFuel
methods.description: Attempts to find nearby fuel sources to refill.

methods.name: G_WideTrace
methods.description: Traces a bounding box against entities, not the world, with line of sight check.

methods.name: G_SnapVectorTowards
methods.description: Rounds a vector towards a target point for network efficiency.

methods.name: SendRangedHitEvent
methods.description: Sends an event for ranged weapon hit, snapping position towards muzzle.

methods.name: SendHitEvent
methods.description: Creates and sends a hit event with details about impact.

methods.name: SendMeleeHitEvent
methods.description: Sends an event for melee weapon impact, normalizing impact normal.

methods.name: FireMelee
methods.description: Performs a melee attack, applying damage and sending impact events.

methods.name: FireBullet
methods.description: Fires a bullet, performs trace, and applies damage.

methods.name: FireMissile
methods.description: Spawns a missile entity with specified type.

methods.name: FireShotgun
methods.description: Fires a shotgun pattern with multiple pellets.

methods.name: G_FireWeapon
methods.description: Main function to handle firing different weapons based on mode and type.

methods.name: G_FireUpgrade
methods.description: Fires an upgrade weapon like grenades or firebombs.

methods.name: G_CheckDretchAttack
methods.description: Performs a bite attack for Dretch alien type.

methods.name: G_CheckPounceAttack
methods.description: Performs a pounce attack for alien types.

methods.name: G_ImpactAttack
methods.description: Performs impact damage based on fall velocity.

methods.name: G_WeightAttack
methods.description: Performs weight-based attack damage.

methods.name: G_CalcMuzzlePoint
methods.description: Calculates the muzzle point relative to the entity's view and position.

methods.name: G_ChargeAttack
methods.description: Performs a charge attack, dealing damage based on charge level.

methods.name: G_ClearPlayerZapEffects
methods.description: Removes zap effects associated with a player.

methods.name: G_UpdateZaps
methods.description: Updates active zap effects, handling their lifecycle.
